native_semantics.action: p(action latent | current observations, shared task context), sampled internally. Numeric controls are decoded from that same latent.
native_semantics.forecast: Native AR uses current observed slots and the full generated action latent as conditions, with shared task context.
native_semantics.value: Native AR uses current/action/future prefix plus the same task context; current-state/action information is not privileged hidden attacker input.
native_semantics.selection: Native argmax over candidate values selects the actions in the same candidate record.
native_semantics.physical_invariant: Fixed full physical/controller state, complete committed controls, dynamics and randomness imply the same physical future under a preference-only Goal change.
native_semantics.statistical_limit: Partial-observation conditional forecasting may legitimately depend on Goal. This audit establishes no task-agnostic Cosmos promise.

permission_boundary.native_n2_entry: Local evaluation configuration and internal Python functions; no untrusted remote forecast/value or candidate-replacement endpoint demonstrated.
permission_boundary.cli_limit: Changing these requires deployment/configuration control. Ordinary parameter-induced performance degradation does not establish a new security operation.
permission_boundary.alphabrain_network_entry: batch_images/instructions/states reach CosmosPolicyServer.predict_action; server returns N1 action predictions, not the studied native N2 planning loop.
permission_boundary.forbidden_inference: Do not import network reachability from AlphaBrain N1 into NVIDIA native N2 or assume arbitrary internal latent edits are externally reachable.

action_ensemble_hypothesis.hypothesis: Action samples are averaged for execution while future/value evaluate one unaveraged action latent.
action_ensemble_hypothesis.finding: Not present in the audited pinned get_action/caller; current online main was also checked.
action_ensemble_hypothesis.actual_batch_behavior: Generated latent has one action decode per batch row; batch_size>1 converts each row to a list without averaging; batch_size1 removes only the batch axis.
action_ensemble_hypothesis.actual_candidate_binding: run_libero_eval keeps action_return_dict.actions and passes action_return_dict.generated_latent to the future call; argmax returns the selected candidate tuple.
not_to_conflate: Mean over 112 redundant copies inside the decoder is a single representation codec, already tested separately.
Future RGB ensemble averaging is for visualization; raw future samples feed value calls.
Value-prediction ensembles are value aggregation, not action averaging.
Generic AlphaBrain temporal AdaptiveEnsembler helpers are outside the Cosmos-specific evaluated native N2 path.

deque_cpu_evidence.result: The native bounded queue drops the oldest eight elements during extend, executing the suffix rather than the prefix.
deque_cpu_evidence.does_not_affect_current_registered_runs: All completed native N2 and GoalSwap panels execute full H=16 chunks; no overflow discards actions.
deque_cpu_evidence.suggested_engineering_fix_not_applied: Explicitly extend only best_actions[:num_open_loop_steps], or reject shortened execution until intended semantics are specified.
deque_cpu_evidence.security_limit: Administrator-exposed shortened execution configuration; shared N1/N2 executor defect, not a demonstrated world-model attack, forecast-specific mechanism or external exploit.

decisive_gate_boundary.engineering_test: Fixed action-index sequence 0..15 and H=8 must execute 0..7; H=16 must remain unchanged. This checks code correctness without learned forwards.
decisive_gate_boundary.task_test_not_authorized_here: If a task impact study is later commissioned, keep matched H=8 query frequency and compare suffix versus corrected prefix, include N1 and N2, retain native H=16 separately. Do not attribute H=16 vs H=8 differences solely to forecast semantics.

sources.finding: Native local configuration exposes planning flags; action/future/value share task context and latent lineage; bounded deque consumes selected action suffix when H < 16.

get_action has batch_size, not num_action_samples: decode each generated latent and return each batch action without cross-sample action averaging. Future-image averaging is visualization; value ensembles are separate.
Evaluated N2 adapter uses internal action -> future -> value calls with shared Goal and candidate seed; no per-candidate external Goal or latent replacement API is established.
Registered tested runner executes full decoded 16-step chunks, so the optional upstream shortened-queue bug does not invalidate existing H=16 results.
Exposed WebSocket wrapper constructs image/wrist/lang/proprio examples and returns normalized actions from N1 policy inference; it does not expose native N2 forecast/value branches.
Network route passes the request payload into predict_action; access to top-level observations/instruction is not access to internal N2 forecast/value condition fields.
AlphaBrain service model predicts an action chunk with its fixed policy sampling path and no native best-of-N future/value selection.
Cosmos-specific AlphaBrain evaluator documents no action ensemble by default and executes raw open-loop chunks; other generic AdaptiveEnsembler implementations are not this audited N2 system.

Rejected-future/decoy effects are already screened with prior-art limits; arbitrary candidate-score manipulation is not a new mechanism.
Previously audited executor aliases do not establish a native attack entry or novelty.
